name: io.github.lucasgfsvd/microsoft365-mcp-server
title: Microsoft 365
description: Microsoft 365 via Graph: mail, calendar, files, Teams, tasks, OneNote, Office. Unmaintained, as-is.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Your Entra app registration's client id. Defaults to a public Microsoft client, fine for trying it out.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ENABLE_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to enable tools that send, create, update or delete. Off by default.
